# Artistic Hive

> > Artistic Hive is a creative education platform offering professional courses and guides on color grading, DaVinci Resolve, and filmmaking techniques taught by industry experts.

Founded by Matteo Martignago, Artistic Hive provides masterclasses and training in video post-production, color correction, and Blackmagic's DaVinci Resolve software. The platform features instruction from award-winning colorists and creators who have worked on major productions.

## Key Topics

- DaVinci Resolve
- Color Grading
- Color Correction
- Blackmagic Resolve
- Video Post-Production
- Filmmaking
- Creative Education
- Online Courses
- Masterclass
- Resolve Training
- Matteo Martignago
- Natasha Leonnet
- HPA Award
- Photography
- Video Editing
